description: Air waybill (AWB) check and carrier lookup: validates the 11-digit AWB (3-digit airline prefix + 8-digit serial with the IATA mod-7 check digit), names the issuing airline and its IATA code from the public track-trace.com carrier list, and returns the airline cargo site and a tracking link. It does not read the shipment status itself (airlines publish it only on their own sites). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

awb.description: Air waybill number: 11 digits, e.g. 020-12345675 or 02012345675
